title: What do you need from a library?
summaryZh: 北爱尔兰正在征求居民对公共图书馆未来的意见，关注阅读、数字服务与友好的公共空间。
levelReason: 编辑估计A2：图书馆日常服务和具体截止日期，短句、常见动词；consultation等词有中文辅助，非官方分级。

sentences.text: On 2 October 2026, Northern Ireland’s Department for Communities invited people to share their views about public libraries.
sentences.zh: 2026年10月2日，北爱尔兰社区部邀请人们分享对公共图书馆的看法。

sentences.text: The department is asking questions before making a new policy for these services.
sentences.zh: 该部门在制定这些服务的新政策之前征求意见。

sentences.text: Libraries offer more than books to borrow and a quiet place to read.
sentences.zh: 图书馆提供的不只是可借阅的书籍和安静的阅读场所。

sentences.text: They also offer information, opportunities to learn and digital services for people of different ages.
sentences.zh: 它们还为不同年龄的人提供信息、学习机会和数字服务。

sentences.text: The consultation asks about people’s experiences and the services and facilities that matter to them.
sentences.zh: 此次意见征集询问人们的体验，以及他们重视哪些服务和设施。

sentences.text: It also looks at the needs of people who will use libraries in the future.
sentences.zh: 它还关注未来图书馆使用者的需要。

sentences.text: The proposed aims include helping people read and learn, supporting wellbeing and encouraging more people to become library members.
sentences.zh: 拟议目标包括帮助人们阅读和学习、支持身心福祉，以及鼓励更多人成为图书馆会员。

sentences.text: Another aim is to make libraries welcoming spaces and to help different organisations work together.
sentences.zh: 另一个目标是把图书馆建成友好的空间，并帮助不同机构合作。

glosses.zh: 友好的／令人感到受欢迎的

sentences.text: People can find the consultation document and questionnaire through the department’s website.
sentences.zh: 人们可以通过该部门网站找到征求意见文件和问卷。

sentences.text: The consultation runs until 25 November 2026, and concerns the direction of library services over the next ten years.
sentences.zh: 意见征集持续至2026年11月25日，涉及未来十年图书馆服务的发展方向。

words.note: views为view复数，在share their views中指分享看法。
different ages指不同年龄，age用复数。
facilities为facility复数，与services并列，指服务场所的设施。

words.zh: 友好的／令人感到受欢迎的
words.note: welcoming修饰spaces，描述让人愿意进入的空间。
questionnaire与consultation document并列，是征集意见所用的问卷。

sentences.note: who will use libraries是关系从句，限定未来的使用者。

questions.text: What do you use your local library for?
questions.zh: 你去当地图书馆做什么？

expressions.text: I go there to read and learn.
expressions.note: 原创口语练习表达，不是来源引语。
